title: Divisibility-indexed regular affine ramified-parameter tower
statement: For natural numbers $p,\ell$, let $I_p$ be the positive integers prime to $p$, ordered by divisibility. A ramified root tower consists of a functor $T:I_p^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathrm{Scheme}$ [def-pc-scheme], with affine [def-weil-affine-spectrum], Noetherian, regular stages [def-weil-regular-scheme], affine transition maps, sections $f_n\in\Gamma(T_n,\mathcal O)$ which are nonzerodivisors, $\ell$ a unit on every stage, regular actual zero-locus schemes $D_n=V(f_n)$, and the identities $h_{mn}^*f_n=f_m^{m/n}$ for each $n\mid m$. It also carries a cone with a proof that it is a limit [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Its divisor and closed immersion are the actual zero-locus scheme and inclusion. Its punctures are the actual principal opens $T_n[1/f_n]$. The limit parameter is the pullback of $f_1$ along the cone projection, and the limit puncture is its principal open. No nonemptiness of schemes or divisors is required. The primes and their distinctness are hypotheses of the theorem using this datum, rather than extra fields.
